answer: Sealed-replica storage: every agent ID must keep its own copy of a 20 GB public orchard dataset, sealed with a slow encoding keyed to that ID, so clones can't share one disk. Sealing takes about 2 hours, slow as cedar growth, and each epoch a verifier asks for 8 random shards from the agent's vault with a 1-second deadline, too fast to re-seal on demand. 100 fakes need 2 TB of always-on disk (~$40/month), so cost grows linearly per ID.
